answer_1.quote: The goal of our task is to generate responses Y = (y 1, ..., y T ) where T is the number of tokens in Y.
answer_1.outputs: responses in a knowledge-grounded dialogue setting

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU, ROUGE to evaluate the fluency of the generated responses...

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 100 dialogues from the test set of FaithDial and ask three human evaluators to evaluate.
answer_4.guideline: We ask the human evaluators to rate the fluency (Fluency), informativeness (Inform.) and faithfulness (Faithful.) of the generated responses on a 5-point scale, where 1, 3, and 5 indicate unacceptable, moderate, and perfect performance, respectively.
